title: The notebook's added cells kept in their column and drawn as cards, and every plot and confusion matrix in the app's one theme
request: The owner: make the UI much cleaner, the layout is not clear, make it more structured; also there are two types of confusion matrix: make all plots and all confusion matrices the same as the theme. With screenshots: the Data science notebook where the agent's cells ran under the Companion column, a cell drawing a blue matplotlib confusion matrix (cmap='Blues'), and the Evaluation page's own matrix (green and pink cells with True negative, False positive and their words).
spec: One look for every chart a notebook cell shows: a confusion matrix is the Evaluation page's own component (chart_confusion sends the counts, the page draws them with binaryMatrix or classMatrix); any matplotlib picture starts in the app's colours (warm paper, clay, quiet axes, a clay colour map); a confusion matrix scikit-learn draws takes the same green-on-the-diagonal, red-off-it cells whatever colour map the cell asked for. The added cells never grow wider than their column, in both looks; in Data science they are cards like the notebook's own cells under a heading 'Cells you added', with the request to the agent as a message box at the end and long printed output scrolling in its box.
plan: Reproduce the owner's screenshot on a local server: a built churn project with added cells (a ConfusionMatrixDisplay with cmap='Blues', a long print, a histogram), run in the project's kernel, screenshot at 1440 px
Measure the overflow: the added cell's width against its column and the companion's left edge
Find why the cells grow: the grids' automatic columns take the width of the longest code line
Add chart_confusion to the kernel's helpers and the page's chart drawing, through the server's chart check
Theme matplotlib at kernel start and redraw scikit-learn's confusion matrix in the app's look
Tell the agent's prompt to use chart_confusion and set no colours; rerun the scripted suites the prompt gate needs
Style the added cells in Data science; check Developer keeps its look
Test, browser checks in both looks, review, record

decisions.decision: A confusion matrix from a cell is the Evaluation page's own component, sent as counts
decisions.why: two kinds of matrix was the owner's complaint; one component drawn from numbers is the same everywhere, in both looks and both themes, and never a picture of rows

decisions.decision: Pictures stay possible, in the app's colours
decisions.why: a person writes matplotlib and scikit-learn as they always do; refusing pictures would break their notebooks, a theme at kernel start keeps them on-brand

decisions.decision: scikit-learn's ConfusionMatrixDisplay.plot is redrawn in the kernel, ignoring cmap, keeping its attributes
decisions.why: the cell in the owner's screenshot asked for Blues itself; only a redraw makes every confusion matrix match, and keeping im_, text_, ax_ and figure_ keeps code that reads them working

decisions.decision: The positive class of a two-by-two is 1 only for a 0/1 (or False/True) target
decisions.why: the exported notebook makes y 1 for POSITIVE (dclab_rnd/studio/export.py); other labels have no known positive, so they get the per-class matrix without the words True positive or False negative

decisions.decision: The overflow fix goes into look.css for both looks; the cards and the composer only into Data science
decisions.why: the overflow is a bug in Developer too; the owner asked to keep Developer's look as it is

decisions.decision: The prompt change is gated like any other
decisions.why: a prompt is code: make agent-eval and make harness-eval ran on it (scripted, no model, nothing spent)

change: dclab_rnd/studio/kernels.py (chart_confusion and _dclab_theme in HELPERS; clean_chart accepts a bounded confusion matrix); dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/evaluation.js (drawChart draws a confusion spec with the Evaluation page's matrices); src/look.css (the added cells' grids take minmax(0, 1fr) and min-width 0; a drawn chart in the body font); src/ds.css (the added cells as cards, 'Cells you added', the composer, long prints scroll, pictures and matrices framed); dclab_rnd/prompts/notebook_cell.md (chart_confusion, no colours); tests/test_notebook_cells.py; evidence AEV-099 and HRN-101 (the scripted suites rerun for the prompt).

findings.defect: The agent's cells ran under the Companion column on the notebook page
findings.scenario: a project's notebook with an added cell whose code or output has a long line, in Data science at 1440 px: the cell is 995 px wide in a 660 px column
findings.cause: #agent-out and .ag-cell are grids with an automatic column, so a long line inside a pre sets the column's width
findings.fix: grid-template-columns minmax(0, 1fr) and min-width 0 on the added cells and their parts, outputs scroll inside their box
findings.test: screenshot script measuring the cell's right edge against the companion's left edge, before and after, both looks

findings.defect: Two kinds of confusion matrix: a blue matplotlib picture in the notebook and the Evaluation page's green and red cards
findings.scenario: the agent writes ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(..., cmap='Blues'); the Evaluation page draws its own matrix
findings.cause: the kernel had app-style helpers for lines and bars only, the prompt sent the agent to matplotlib for anything else, and matplotlib drew its defaults
findings.fix: chart_confusion drawn by the page with the Evaluation page's matrix; ConfusionMatrixDisplay redrawn in the same colours; the prompt names chart_confusion

findings.defect: Every other plot was in matplotlib's default blue
findings.scenario: a histogram cell shows tab:blue bars and a boxed frame beside the app's clay and paper
findings.cause: the kernel started matplotlib with its defaults
findings.fix: rcParams at kernel start: paper ground, quiet grid, no top and right spines, titles left and bold, the app's colour cycle, a clay colour map
findings.test: the new test reads image.cmap from the kernel; screenshots of a histogram and lines

findings.defect: The theme printed a font warning in every cell
findings.scenario: a cell with a title prints 'findfont: Failed to find font weight semibold for DejaVu Sans' to stderr
findings.cause: matplotlib's bundled font has no semibold weight
findings.fix: bold for titles and the matrix's numbers
findings.test: the new test asserts no findfont text and no stderr output

findings.defect: The app's matrix inside a cell's output was drawn in the monospace font
findings.scenario: chart_confusion's matrix in a cell shows its words in the code font
findings.cause: .cell-out sets the mono font and pre-wrap for printed text, and a chart sits in the same box
findings.fix: .cell-out.cell-chart uses the body font and normal white space

findings.defect: A long print made one cell taller than the screen several times over
findings.scenario: a cell printing a 20 by 20 array and a long sentence
findings.cause: the output box had no height limit
findings.fix: in Data science a printed output scrolls inside a 360 px box; pictures and charts are never cut

findings.defect: The test build timed out when the scripted suites ran beside it
findings.scenario: make harness-eval running while the local server ran the five stages
findings.cause: the sandbox's CPU was shared by both
findings.fix: ran them one after the other
findings.test: the build finished in about four minutes alone

findings.defect: Passing text_kw to the redrawn ConfusionMatrixDisplay.plot raised an error
findings.scenario: from_predictions(y, p, text_kw={'fontsize': 8}) fails with 'got multiple values for keyword argument fontsize'
findings.cause: the redraw passed its own fontsize, colour and weight beside **text_kw
findings.fix: one dict of the theme's text settings, updated with the person's text_kw so theirs win

findings.defect: A normalized confusion matrix showed wrong percentages and colours
findings.scenario: normalize='pred' on counts [[80, 20], [10, 10]] printed 0.888...|57% where the shares are 89% and 67% of the predicted columns
findings.cause: the redraw took a row share of values that were already shares, and printed floats at full precision
findings.fix: a float matrix is coloured by its own values and printed with '.2g' (scikit-learn's default), with no second line

findings.defect: include_values=False left text_ as an array of None
findings.scenario: code that checks 'if disp.text_ is not None' then loops over it fails with AttributeError
findings.cause: text_ was always made an array
findings.fix: text_ is None when values are not drawn, as in scikit-learn

findings.defect: chart_confusion chose its labels badly in three cases
findings.scenario: one class only gave a 1x1 matrix the page drops; ten or more numeric classes sorted 0, 1, 10, 2; a multiclass notebook showed 0, 1, 2 instead of the class names
findings.cause: labels were the values seen, sorted as text, and the notebook's labels list was not read
findings.fix: a 0/1 target always gives [0, 1]; numbers sort as numbers; an index target takes the names of the notebook's labels list; display_labels names them by hand
findings.test: tests/test_notebook_cells.py: [0,0,0] gives 2x2, [2,10,1] sorts 1,2,10, labels cat/dog/eel shown

measurements.name: added cell's width against its column, Data science at 1440 px
measurements.gate: the cell's right edge left of the companion's left edge
measurements.result: before: a 995 px cell in a 660 px column, 0 px from the companion; after: the cells end at the column's edge (980 px), the companion starts at 1004 px
limits: headless Chromium in a cloud sandbox
one churn project with four added cells

measurements.name: scripted suites for the prompt change
measurements.gate: make agent-eval stores a result; make harness-eval passes
measurements.result: AEV-099 stored; HRN-101 17 of 17 right on every step, EUR 0
limits: scripted policies, not a live model: whether the model now writes chart_confusion is not measured here

measurements.name: browser checks flow, pages, mobile, dsmode in both looks
measurements.gate: every check passes in both looks
measurements.result: all pass in Data science and in Developer
limits: headless Chromium in a cloud sandbox, not the owner's Mac browsers

outcome: The added cells stay in their column in both looks; in Data science they are cards like the notebook's own, under 'Cells you added', with the request box at the end. Every confusion matrix from a cell is the Evaluation page's own (chart_confusion) or drawn in its colours (scikit-learn's display), and every other plot starts in the app's colours.
lessons: A grid or flex child with long preformatted text needs minmax(0, 1fr) or min-width 0, or the text sets the layout's width
Two looks of one thing come from two code paths: send the numbers to the one component instead of restyling a picture
Theme a library at kernel start, then check its warnings: a missing font weight prints in every cell
Run heavy suites one after another in a shared sandbox; a timeout beside them says nothing about the code
When replacing a library's method, keep its contract: every argument it takes, every attribute it sets, and what it sets to None
risks: Redrawing ConfusionMatrixDisplay.plot changes a person's own picture: a colour map they choose is ignored, and the colorbar is not drawn
Whether the model now writes chart_confusion is not measured with a live model; the scripted suites only check the prompt gate
Pictures stay white in the dark theme
